subject: Re: Reserved commit counterproposal & packaging options for MediApps Dedicated pool
body:
From: Anna Black <anna.black@mediapps.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@mediapps.com
Date: 2026-11-02T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity proposal

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the call earlier. To summarize MediApps' immediate needs:
- We expect steady inference demand for our imaging pipeline: ~1.8M tokens/day steady state, peak bursts up to 3M tokens/day.
- We'd like a committed Dedicated GPU pool to guarantee throughput for our clinical features (low latency, steady tail). Initial sizing ask: equivalent of 8 A100 GPUs with burst capacity.
- We're evaluating total cost of ownership and need a pricing proposal that can compete with our incumbent vendor — they've offered us a 30% discount on list for a 12-month committed pool.

Questions:
1) Can Redwood match or provide a comparable economic package (committed monthly rate + burst credits)?
2) What throughput SLOs can you guarantee for the commit and what credit structure if SLOs miss?
3) Any flexibility on contract term (12 vs 24 months) and upfront payment options?

Procurement is looped in (procurement@mediapps.com). We also need evidenced SLAs and an estimate of onboarding credits for migration.

Thanks,
Anna Black
VP of Product, MediApps, Inc.

---

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Anna Black <anna.black@mediapps.com>
Cc: procurement@mediapps.com
Date: 2026-11-03T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity proposal

Anna — thanks for the clear summary. I can absolutely put together a committed pricing proposal and packaging options. A couple quick clarifying items before I send numbers:
- Is the "8 A100-equivalent" pool a hard minimum for go-live, or would you consider a 6->8 ramp over 30-60 days?
- For burst behavior, what percentage of peak traffic is sustained vs short spikes (seconds/minutes vs hours)?

Plan: I will draft two alternatives:
A) 12-month commit (8 GPU-eq) with a list-discounted rate and burst credits;
B) 24-month commit with deeper discount and onboarding credits.

I'll share an internal pricing request tonight and follow up with a documented counterproposal by Wednesday. Attaching our baseline terms and SLA matrix for context.

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_PO_terms_v1.pdf, SLA_throughput_matrix.xlsx

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

---

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-04T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: FW: MediApps - discount ask & commit sizing

Team — forwarding Anna's ask. Key points: 8 GPU-eq committed pool, competitor quoted 30% off list for 12 months. MediApps is a strategic vertical account (healthcare imaging) with strong upsell potential across multiple product lines.

Request: I need an exception/approval for pricing and packaging. Proposed options I want to float:
1) Standard: 12-month committed pool (8 GPU-eq) at 18% off list + 3 months of onboarding burst credits (50k token-hours) and 99.5% throughput SLA with credits.
2) Aggressive: 12-month commit at 25% off list + 2% closing credit (one-time) IF legal signs a 12-month PO by 11/15 and we get a minimum ARR threshold of $X (private). This would require exec sign-off.
3) Alternative: 24-month commit, 20% off list, additional 6 months of discounted burst pricing and priority placement on capacity for the first 6 months.

Technical note (Evelyn) — we need to confirm how throughput SLOs map to their token distribution and whether we can honor a hard 99.9% SLA vs soft SLO with credits.

Attachments: MediApps_MLP_usage_forecast.csv

Thoughts? I'll consolidate and send counterproposal to MediApps after we agree on an approach.

Thanks,
Soojin

---

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FW: MediApps - discount ask & commit sizing

Soojin — thanks for the summary. MediApps looks strategic; I'm comfortable with an exception, but finance needs to sign off. High level:
- Do not go below 15% without a contractual lever (multi-year or usage milestones).
- 25% is a stretch; acceptable only if tied to a 24-month commit + minimum ARR / termination penalty.
- Approve the 18% baseline if Laura can validate margins and Legal approves PO terms.

Laura — can you run the margin impact quickly (include expected burst credit usage) and confirm whether we can approve 18% for 12 months without CFO sign-off?

Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

---

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FW: MediApps - discount ask & commit sizing

Vivek / Soojin — ran the numbers. Key points:
- Baseline 12-month commit at 18% reduces expected gross margin by ~6 percentage points vs list; with the proposed onboarding credits (3 months), net contribution in year one is still positive but thin if they use most burst credits.
- Finance can approve up to 18% for a 12-month contract only if we secure a 60-day early termination fee (to protect runway) and require invoice upfront for the first 2 months. Anything deeper (>=20%) requires CFO escalation.

Recommend we present Option 1 (18%) as our commercial counter and keep Option 2 (25%) as an executive-only concession for a 24-month locked commit and stricter payment terms.

Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Finance

---

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T14:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FW: MediApps - discount ask & commit sizing

Quick tech notes for the Offer:
- We can guarantee a 99.5% throughput SLO at the committed pool size (8 GPU-eq) with automatic burst routing for short spikes.
- For 99.9% hard SLA we'd need either a larger committed pool or cross-region fallback (introduces latency risk).
- SLO credits: propose 5% of monthly commit per missed percentage point below 99.5%, capped at 30% monthly credit.
- We'll include a soft capacity ramp (6->8 GPUs over 45 days) as an onboarding option.

Evelyn Hart
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Anna Black <anna.black@mediapps.com>
Cc: procurement@mediapps.com
Date: 2026-11-06T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity proposal

Anna — thanks for your patience. Based on internal approvals and technical review, here's our counteroffer. I want to be explicit so procurement can review and take to legal: 

Counterproposal (Option A - recommended):
- Commitment: 12 months, Dedicated GPU pool equivalent to 8 A100s (can ramp 6->8 over first 45 days).
- Pricing: 18% discount off published dedicated list rate, billed monthly.
- Onboarding credits: 3 months of burst credits (50k token-hours) plus 40 hours of migration assistance from our SE team.
- Throughput SLO: 99.5% monthly; SLO credit = 5% of monthly commit per missed percentage point below 99.5% (cap 30%).
- Flexibility: Option to scale pool size upward with 30 days' notice and prorated pricing.
- Terms: 60-day early termination fee if canceled within first 6 months; invoice for first 2 months due at signing.

Option B (executive concession - requires sign-off):
- 12 months, 25% off list + 2% one-time closing credit OR 24 months, 25% off + priority capacity for first 6 months.
- B requires legal acceptance of additional revenue guarantees and finance approval.

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_PO_terms_v1.pdf, SLA_throughput_matrix.xlsx
DocuSign: https://docusign.net/xyz/sign/mediapps

If you want us to try to match the 30% incumbent offer, we can explore a 24-month locked commit with a higher minimum ARR and a staged price reduction (milestone-driven). That would require executive approval.

Can you confirm which option MediApps prefers and whether procurement needs a revision to the SLO credit formula? If you accept Option A we can get a PO into Legal and DocuSign started today.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

---

From: procurement@mediapps.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Anna Black <anna.black@mediapps.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity proposal - final pricing check

Soojin — thanks for the clear counteroffer. Procurement is generally comfortable with Option A, but they asked one final ask before we route to Legal: can Redwood provide an additional onboarding credit (2% one-time credit on first invoice) or move to 20% discount (instead of 18%) to match closer to incumbent economics? This is the final commercial lever we can use in procurement to close by 11/15.

If this requires executive approval, please escalate — Anna and I would like to close quickly.

Procurement Team
MediApps, Inc.
